analysis.reason: 3거래일 연속 관망 유지. RSI는 과매도 구간 진입 후 소폭 반등했으나 여전히 30선 초반. MACD 히스토그램은 음수 구간에서 큰 변화 없이 유지 중. ADX 29.9로 추세는 뚜렷하나, -DI가 +DI보다 우위에 있어 하락 압력이 더 강한 상태. 5일 평균 거래량 대비 0.39배로 거래량 부재 속 횡보 구간 지속.
analysis.reasonEn: 3 consecutive sessions of wait-and-see. RSI entered oversold and saw a slight bounce but remains in the low 30s. MACD histogram is holding steady in negative territory with little change. ADX at 29.9 indicates a clear trend, but -DI is above +DI, showing stronger downward pressure. Trading volume is subdued at 0.39x the 5-day average, continuing a sideways consolidation.

analysis.weeklyConflictEn: Weekly RSI at 39.8 shows weakness, weekly MACD histogram at 0.0007 signals a bearish turn, and weekly ADX at 18.0 indicates a non-trending phase. The daily chart has entered oversold territory but lacks trend formation, thus maintaining a wait-and-see approach based on daily indicators.
